name: bookipi
description: Run your business from chat — invoices, customers, expenses, deals, proposals, eSign contracts, meetings, reports and your website. Installs the Bookipi skill; pair it with the `bookipi` CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Run your small business from chat
interface.longDescription: Run your business from chat. Invoices and the whole invoice document family (estimates, credit notes, delivery notes, purchase orders), customers and payment history, expenses and receipt scanning, deals, AI-written proposals, eSign contracts, recorded meetings with transcripts and AI summaries, reports and dashboards, and your Bookipi website. Installs the Bookipi skill — presentation rules, operation routing, and 21 flow playbooks (morning brief, collections run, win a deal, quick quote, stalled-deal recovery, website review) — and drives them through the `bookipi` CLI, which it fetches on first use. Sign in with your Bookipi account in the browser; no API key to manage.
defaultPrompt: Create an invoice for Acme — $5,000 consulting.
